02/16.02.2024: Heard the parties.

2. The applicant, who is in custody since 21.08.2023, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Daltonganj Sadar P.S. Case No.91 of 2023 for the offence under Sections 376, 511 and 354 IPC and Section 10 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj.
3.

entities.text: Daltonganj Sadar P.S. Case No.91 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It has been submitted by the counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR/ Complaint Case along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on the part of the applicant(s).
4. Innocence has been claimed and participation in the trial has been assured.
It has been submitted that due to neighbourhood dispute, this false case has been lodged.
Charge has already been framed on 17.10.2023.
On the above facts, prayer for bail has been made.

5. On the other hand, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that the mother is an eye witness to the incident.
6.
Considering the nature of allegation, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant (s) on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the applicant(s) stands rejected.
7. However, trial court is directed to expedite the trial as early as possible.
